patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@

 [resource]
 script = ExtResource("1_tuning")
-ledge_gap_width = 6.6
+ledge_gap_width = 3.0
 ledge_bypass_deaths = 5
 marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
 marker_emission = 0.0
patches.rationale: Player fell four times questioning if the jump was possible, so narrowing the gap from 6.6 to 3.0 makes the opening jump reliably clearable.

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -6,8 +6,8 @@
 script = ExtResource("1_tuning")
 ledge_gap_width = 6.6
 ledge_bypass_deaths = 5
-marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
-marker_emission = 0.0
+marker_color = Color(1, 0.85, 0.2, 1)
+marker_emission = 4.0
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
patches.rationale: Player circled the plaza for 40 seconds seeing no beacon, so a bright emissive marker makes the exit visible above the pillars from the entrance.

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
 ledge_bypass_deaths = 5
 marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
 marker_emission = 0.0
-switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
+switch_prompt_text = "Press the red button on the high shelf to open the gate."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"

patches.rationale: Player spent 29 seconds trying the gate before spotting the button, so an explicit prompt links the gate to the red button on the shelf.
patches.summary: name red button in gate objective

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -9,6 +9,6 @@
 marker_color = Color(0.816, 0.486, 0.337, 1)
 marker_emission = 0.0
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
-enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
+enemy_aggro_delay = 4.0
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
 corridor_segments = 12
patches.rationale: The enemy killed the player twice within seconds of the unseen landing, so a 4 second aggro delay gives time to land, see it and react.
patches.summary: give time before drop enemy charges

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -10,5 +10,5 @@
 marker_emission = 0.0
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
-fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
+fork_arrow_points_to = "right"
 corridor_segments = 12
patches.rationale: Player trusted the left-pointing EXIT sign into a dead end, so pointing the arrow right sends them toward the corridor branch.
patches.summary: point exit sign to corridor branch

patches.diff:
--- a/level/tuning.tres
+++ b/level/tuning.tres
@@ -11,4 +11,4 @@
 switch_prompt_text = "Find a way through."
 enemy_aggro_delay = 0.0
 fork_arrow_points_to = "left"
